name: Benzethidine
summary: Benzethidine is a 4-phenylpiperidine derivative that is related to the clinically used opioid analgesic drug pethidine (meperidine, or Demerol).

pharmacology.text: It has similar effects to other opioid derivatives, such as analgesia, sedation, nausea and respiratory depression.

uses.text: Benzethidine is a 4-phenylpiperidine derivative that is related to the clinically used opioid analgesic drug pethidine (meperidine, or Demerol). Benzethidine is not currently used in medicine and is a Class A/Schedule I drug which is controlled under UN drug conventions.

sideEffects.en: It is not used in medicine and has barely been studied in people. Like other opioids it can cause drowsiness, nausea and slowed breathing, and strong opioids can cause fatal overdose and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它未用於醫療，在人體中也幾乎沒有研究。和其他鴉片類一樣，它可能造成嗜睡、噁心與呼吸變慢，而強效鴉片類可能導致致命過量與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未用于医疗，在人体中也几乎没有研究。和其他鸦片类一样，它可能造成嗜睡、恶心与呼吸变慢，而强效鸦片类可能导致致命过量与成瘾。

fact.en: It is pethidine with a benzyl ether group added, part of a wave of 4-phenylpiperidine opioids made in the 1950s to explore what changes to pethidine would do.
fact.zh: 苄替啶是在配西汀上加一個苄基醚的產物，屬於 1950 年代為探索配西汀結構改變效果而合成的一批 4-苯基哌啶鴉片類藥物。
fact.zhHans: 苄替啶是在配西汀上加一个苄基醚的产物，属于 1950 年代为探索配西汀结构改变效果而合成的一批 4-苯基哌啶鸦片类药物。
